bull_bear.body:
- Capital adequacy strengthened YoY: CRAR 16.67% (was 15.98%), Tier I 14.78% (was 13.68%) and CET-1 13.91% (was 12.69%); Total Capital Funds of Rs 19,116 crore against Total Risk Weighted Average of Rs 1,14,685 crore at Jun 30, 2026.
- Equity was last raised via a 'QIP of Rs 750 crores in FY 2023-24 oversubscribed 34x'.
- Milestones cited: 'Market Capitalization crossed Rs 20,000 crores and Net-worth crossed Rs 15,000 crores'; Net Worth stated at Rs 15,577 crores, Up 15.0%, with Book Value Per Share of Rs 141.46 at Jun-26.
- Capital base is unchanged rather than expanded: Capital at Rs 110.13 crore across Jun 30 2025, Mar 31 2026 and Jun 30 2026 (0% change), and total shares of 110,11,82,463 with '-' YoY change. The deck makes no dividend statement or payout policy.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- Self-described as the 'Oldest Private Sector Bank in India', incorporated on October 1, 1938, catering to retail, corporate, agricultural and MSME customers.
- Home-market density is the core of the franchise: 1008 branches, of which 835 operate in the UT of J&K and 37 in the UT of Ladakh, with 136 branches across 20 other states/UTs. A later slide states 872 branches in J&K and Ladakh (JKL), 136 outside JKL and presence in 22 States/UTs - the deck gives both 20 and 22 for the out-of-JKL state count.
- Concentration is quantified: J&K and Ladakh account for 83.2% of Total Deposits and 61.9% of Gross Advances, with Rest of India at 16.8% and 38.1% respectively.
- 'The Govt of UT of J&K is a majority holder, however the Bank enjoys full operational autonomy' - promoters (Governments of UTs of J&K and Ladakh) held 59.40% as on June 30, 2026, unchanged YoY.
- 'Designated as Agency Bank by RBI for conducting government banking in UTs of J&K and Ladakh', which the deck frames as a structural market-presence advantage.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Rating] 'India Ratings has upgraded the Bank's long-term issuer rating to INDAA- from INDA+ with stable outlook' (agency-code spacing lost in extraction).
- [Group structure] Wholly owned subsidiary JKB Financial Services Limited; the Bank is also the Sponsor bank of Jammu and Kashmir Grameen Bank, and sponsored two RRBs historically.
- [Leadership] MD & CEO Mr. Amitava Chatterjee, previously DMD SBI and MD & CEO of SBI Capital Markets; Part Time Non-Executive Chairman Mr. Sankarasubramanian Krishnan, ex-MD & CEO of Punjab & Sind Bank and Tamilnad Mercantile Bank. The Board also seats serving IAS officers of the J&K and Ladakh administrations alongside a retired RBI Chief General Manager and a past President of ICAI.
- [Corporate credit concentration] Of the Rs 45,644.12 crore of corporate advances eligible for rating at June 30, 2026, AAA accounts for 71.8% across just 32 borrowers, while 'BB & Below' is 6.0% spread over 169 borrowers - the largest borrower count sits in the weakest bucket.
business.title: Notable from the deck

deepdive.thesis: The deck positions J&K Bank as India's oldest private sector bank (incorporated October 1, 1938) and the dominant, majority government-owned banking franchise of the UTs of J&K and Ladakh - RBI-designated Agency Bank for both - whose total business has crossed Rs 3 trillion while a smaller pan-India network is built out alongside a claimed asset-quality turnaround.
